( #{item.fid}, #{item.billNo}, #{item.documentStatus}, #{item.approverId}, #{item.approveDate}, #{item.modifierId}, #{item.createDate}, #{item.creatorId}, #{item.modifyDate}, #{item.cancelDate}, #{item.canceler}, #{item.cancelStatus}, #{item.description}, #{item.billType}, #{item.trustteed}, #{item.workShopId0}, #{item.prdOrgId}, #{item.plannerId}, #{item.date}, #{item.ownerTypeId}, #{item.ownerId}, #{item.workGroupId}, #{item.businessType}, #{item.isRework}, #{item.isEntrust}, #{item.enTrustOrgId}, #{item.ppbomType}, #{item.issueMtrl}, #{item.isQcmo}, #{item.zghyPrintTimes}, #{item.ukptZhrkrq}, #{item.ukptZzllrq}, #{item.ukptCjfs}, #{item.ukptDlxm}, #{item.xgbwLlts} )

select a.fid as fid -- 主键 ,a.bill_no as billNo -- 单据编号 ,a.document_status as documentStatus -- 单据状态 ,a.approver_id as approverId -- 审批人 ,a.approve_date as approveDate -- 审批日期 ,a.modifier_id as modifierId -- 修改人 ,a.create_date as createDate -- 创建日期 ,a.creator_id as creatorId -- 创建人 ,a.modify_date as modifyDate -- 修改日期 ,a.cancel_date as cancelDate -- 作废日期 ,a.canceler as canceler -- 作废人 ,a.cancel_status as cancelStatus -- 作废状态 ,a.description as description -- 备注 ,a.bill_type as billType -- 单据类型 ,a.prd_org_id as prdOrgId -- 生产组织 ,a.planner_id as plannerId -- 计划员 ,a.date as date -- 单据日期 ,a.work_group_id as workGroupId -- 计划组 ,a.ukpt_zhrkrq as ukptZhrkrq -- 最后入库时间 ,a.ukpt_zzllrq as ukptZzllrq -- 最早领料时间 ,b.f_entry_id as lineEntryId -- 明细主键 ,b.p_id as linePId -- 头表id ,b.f_product_type as productType -- 产品类型 ,b.f_material_id as materialId -- 物料编码 ,b.f_material_number as materialNumber -- 物料编码 ,b.f_material_name as materialName -- 物料名称 ,b.f_specification as specification -- 规格 ,b.f_bom_id as bomId -- bom版本 ,b.f_status as lineStatus -- 业务状态 ,b.f_status_label as lineStatusLabel -- 业务状态 ,b.f_plan_start_date as planStartDate -- 计划开工 ,b.f_plan_finish_date as planFinishDate -- 计划完工 ,b.f_sale_order_no as saleOrderNo -- 需求单据 ,b.f_schedule_status as scheduleStatus -- 排产状态 from erp_production_order a left join erp_production_order_line b on a.fid = b.p_id where a.document_status = 'C' and cast(b.f_status as unsigned) >= 3
and a.bill_no like concat('%', #{query.billNo}, '%')
and a.prd_org_id = #{query.prdOrgId}
and b.f_material_number like concat('%', #{query.materialId}, '%')
and b.f_plan_start_date >= str_to_date(concat(#{query.planStartBegin}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and b.f_plan_start_date <= str_to_date(concat(#{query.planStartEnd}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and b.f_plan_finish_date >= str_to_date(concat(#{query.planFinishBegin}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and b.f_plan_finish_date <= str_to_date(concat(#{query.planFinishEnd}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
order by a.date desc, a.bill_no desc, b.f_material_number desc
